verdict.rationale: Inngest documents keyed concurrency limits applied per unique key value such as a user ID. It also documents rate limiting and built-in flow control, throttling and concurrency handling. Together these support per-tenant isolation rather than one shared FIFO queue. The pack has no evidence of assigning priorities to runs, and fairness is only implied by the per-key limits rather than described as a fair-queuing scheduler. Missing for 10: run prioritization, explicit fair-queuing or tenant-fairness documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
